Create ONE isolated, anatomically accurate adult bird, full body including bill, feet and complete tail, wings folded. Natural-history scientific plate style: extremely fine ink and coloured-pencil detail with subtle watercolour shading, realistic feather texture, crisp edges, restrained natural colours, softly modelled volume. Match the visual character of a meticulously drawn green tree frog scientific illustration, not a photograph, cartoon or vector icon. A clean elegant three-quarter side view, bird facing RIGHT, head readable, natural resting posture with both feet visible, no perch or environmental objects. Bird fills about 85% of a square canvas with clear margins on every side. True transparent background. No labels, letters, watermark, border, ground, shadow or scene. No extra birds, no duplicate limbs. Subject: adult male COMMON KINGFISHER, Alcedo atthis. Compact small kingfisher, relatively large head, long straight pointed ALL-DARK bill, very short tail, bright azure-blue back and tail, turquoise-blue crown and wing coverts with fine pale blue spotting, warm orange-rufous cheek and underparts, white throat and white side-neck patch, tiny orange-red feet. Keep true kingfisher proportions and diagnostic plumage, not a generic blue bird.
